title: John A. Reilly Clinical Professor of Law, Emeritus
bio: Susan Crawford is the John A. Reilly Clinical Professor of Law, emeritus at Harvard Law School. She previously was Obama’s special assistant to the president for science, technology, and innovation policy and co-led the FCC transition team between his and the Bush administrations.
